summary.one_liner: A community-curated "awesome" list of blog posts, books, courses and other resources to help people grow as a CTO.
summary.what_it_does: This is a link list rather than software. It was originally published as an ebook, "How to become a better CTO." Entries are grouped under topic headings such as Basics, Lessons Learned from CTOs & Founders, Management, Team, Culture, Business, Money, Networking, Work-life balance, Public speaking, Remote Teams, Sales, Productivity and Hiring. Each entry gives a title, a type label (blog post, book, PDF, course, video, tool, etc.) and a short description, sometimes with the author's background. Coverage includes what the CTO role means, hiring a CTO, equity and compensation, and running remote teams. The README also has Contributing and Code of conduct sections and a Brainhub-funded maintenance note.
use_cases: Learning what a CTO role involves
Reading lessons from experienced CTOs and founders
Finding resources on hiring a CTO or senior engineers
Researching startup CTO equity and compensation
Improving technical leadership and people management skills
notable: Curated collection of external articles, books, courses and tools for CTOs
Entries labeled by type (blog post, book, PDF, course, video, tool)
Covers both technical leadership and non-technical topics like sales, money and networking
Includes a Hiring section on finding and evaluating a CTO candidate
Originally published as an ebook titled How to become a better CTO
caveats: Only links and short descriptions; the resources themselves are hosted elsewhere and may change or disappear
Some entries are dated or tied to specific people and companies
